data.one_liner: Detect and filter offensive language and bad words in text input.
data.what_it_does: BadWord Guard is a Flutter plugin that scans text inputs to detect and highlight offensive words or phrases. It also allows you to automatically replace inappropriate words with custom characters or alternatives.
use_when: You need to filter user-generated content for bad words.
You want to perform real-time text moderation on text inputs.
avoid_when: You require complex AI-driven sentiment analysis beyond keyword filtering.
You need natural language understanding that goes past literal word matching.
strengths: Provides easy-to-use methods for detecting and filtering bad language.
Supports real-time processing of user input.
Allows customizable word lists and replacement options.
weaknesses: Relies on basic keyword matching which can be bypassed with creative spelling.
Limited documentation on advanced customization options in the README.
